author: asymptotejrnl
title: Asymptote seeking illustrators and guest artists
content: Asymptote is seeking designers and guest artists! Literature crosses borders through words—but every issue of Asymptote also needs a visual language of its own. We are looking for imaginative designers to join our international team, as well as guest artists interested in shaping the look and atmosphere of a single issue. Designers will help translate the journal’s literary vision into compelling visual form across our website, social media, newsletters, campaigns, and other digital materials. We are also inviting illustrators to collaborate with us on a single quarterly issue, working alongside our editorial team. Interested? Attach a cover letter to your portfolio and send an application to editors@asymptotejournal.com.

author: abdnartmuseums
title: Aberdeen Museums Micro-Commissions 2026 open
content: Micro-Commissions Spotlight: Kirsty Hilda. Aberdeen Art Gallery & Museums sat down with previous Micro-Commissions awardee Kirsty Hilda. Micro-Commissions 2026 is now open for applications. Submission deadline is 4 October 2026. Check this year’s brief via the link in bio. Contact: Instagram @abdnartmuseums, application link in bio.
